text:
Eve S: starting staged rollout chat-model v3 -> 15% global. change window 23:00-00:00 PT. tagging for stop/go. watching p99 latency, tokenizer errors, and conversation-level regressions.
DeployBot: Deploy triggered: id=deploy_2026_03_21_3456789012; wave=15%; regions=[us,eu,ap]; status=canary. console: https://deploys.internal/deploy_2026_03_21_3456789012
Frank G: metrics subscription live. set alerts for tokenizer_mismatch and p99>3000ms.
Gina H: quick check — APAC starting to see tokenization EOL errors on long inputs: tokenizer_errs=1.6% (baseline 0.02%). stacktraces indicate unknown token sequences upstream.
Infra Oncall: looking. AP hosts show a new runtime warning about tokenizer fallback to byte-pair; also see spike in runtime decode exceptions. no OOMs.
Eve S: big red flag for customer chat flows. proposal: immediate regional pin to v2 in ap while we triage, keep us/eu rolling at 15%. vote: rollback AP / pin AP / hold global?
Frank G: +1 pin AP to v2 for new sessions. keep others live to avoid mass rollback.
Gina H: +1 pin. I'll run targeted replay tests on AP sample traffic to reproduce.
DeployBot: Routing change: deploy_2026_03_21_3456789012 -> regions: us=15%, eu=15%, ap=0% new_sessions (pinned->chat-model-v2). note: ap drained for new sessions, existing sessions unaffected.
Infra Oncall: applied runtime hotfix to logging to capture raw tokens. no infra-scale required yet.
Gina H: replay results: 120/500 sessions show tokenizer EOL on messages >1024 tokens. appears related to tokenizer upgrade handling of long sequences.
ProductOps: customers on AP small but high-value. recommend customer comms if rollback extends beyond window.
Eve S: agree. short term: pin AP to v2 and continue triage. longer term: revert tokenizer change in v3 or patch tokenizer lib. Gina, can you validate patch in staging?
Gina H: patch prepared: revert tokenizer 1.4.2->1.3.9 and add safe-truncation. pushing to staging now.
DeployBot: Canary update: status=paused (manual hold). regions={us:15%, eu:15%, ap:0% pinned->v2}. awaiting triage results.
Frank G: product ok with segmented approach. will prep quick FAQ if we need to notify.
Gina H: staging tests pass: no tokenizer EOL on long messages, similarity QA okay. pushing patch to eu first? or ap only?
Eve S: ap only for now. deploy patch to ap canary at 5% then monitor 10m. if green, lift pin and resume full rollout.
DeployBot: Patch deploy command queued: patch_id=patch_2026_03_21_3456789025 -> target=ap, wave=5%.
Infra Oncall: monitoring. set alert for tokenizer_errs in ap at 0.5%.
Gina H: AP patch live at 3456789030. initial smoke: tokenizer_errs -> 0.05%, p99 latency stable. running 1k replay.
Frank G: product thumbs-up so far. hold until replay done.
DeployBot: patch progress: patch_2026_03_21_3456789025 -> status=complete in ap-canary.
Gina H: replay completed: 1k sessions, 2 failures (timed out during warmup), none tokenizer EOL. similarity within 0.1% of baseline.
Eve S: unanimous: resume rollout. plan: remove ap pin, ramp ap to 10% then 15% over 10m. if tokenizer_errs >0.4% anywhere, abort and rollback ap to v2.
DeployBot: Traffic command executed: remove pin for ap; ap=10% now. next checkpoint at 3456789070.
ProductOps: will stand by for customer comms if needed.
Eve S: final note: we'll include a short release note about tokenizer tweak and fallback safety in the changelog. leaving thread open until final checkpoint at 3456789040.
Frank G: thanks team.
Gina H: monitoring live. all green at last check.
DeployBot: last update at 3456789040 -> status=progressing, global={us:15%, eu:15%, ap:10%}, note=watching tokenizer metrics.
